notes.win_rate_definition: metrics.daily_win_rate is share of DAYS with positive equity change, not trade-level win rate. Cash/flat days count as losses/non-wins, so SMA strategies often show ~30%.
notes.winRate_field: new_100 posts write winRate from metrics['win_rate'] which does not exist; field is null.
notes.start_equity: First mark is after the opening rebalance, so start_equity is ~100000 minus 7bps (5 commission + 2 slip).
notes.clones: Identical (template, assets, cagr, sharpe, trades) means many papers share one ETF proxy.
